battleFormations.name: Renegade Raiders
battleFormations.effect: Raiders and Reavers: HERETIC ASTARTES ranged weapons gain [ASSAULT]; attacks against units within/near objectives gain +1 AP.

battleFormations.name: Deceptors
battleFormations.effect: Masters of Misdirection: Select 2/3/4 LEGIONARIES or CULTIST MOB units (by battle size) to gain the Infiltrators ability until the end of the battle.

battleFormations.name: Dread Talons
battleFormations.effect: Terror Descends (Aura): Enemy Battle-shocked or below-starting-strength units within 12" must take a Battle-shock test in their own Command phase, with -1 to that test.

battleFormations.name: Fellhammer Siege-host
battleFormations.effect: Iron Fortitude: (Partial capture — concerns defence against high-Strength ranged attacks targeting HERETIC ASTARTES excluding DAMNED units; verify full text on Wahapedia.)

battleFormations.name: Veterans of the Long War
battleFormations.effect: Focus of Hatred: Select one enemy unit as your focus of hatred each Command phase; re-roll Hit rolls for attacks made by HERETIC ASTARTES (excluding DAMNED) units targeting it.

artefacts.name: Daemon Hammer
artefacts.effect: Enhancement named in source notes — exact rules text/cost not confirmed; check codex/Wahapedia.

artefacts.name: Disciple of Khorne
artefacts.effect: Enhancement named in source notes — exact rules text/cost not confirmed; check codex/Wahapedia.

artefacts.name: Eager for Vengeance
artefacts.effect: [HERETIC ASTARTES (excl. DAMNED)] The bearer's unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back; add 1 to Charge rolls against its focus of hatred.

artefacts.name: Eye of Abaddon
artefacts.effect: [HERETIC ASTARTES (excl. DAMNED)] Each time the focus of hatred is destroyed, you can spend 1CP to return a destroyed model to the bearer's unit on a 4+.

artefacts.name: Mark of Legend
artefacts.effect: [HERETIC ASTARTES (excl. DAMNED)] Once per turn, you can re-roll a Hit roll, Wound roll, or saving throw made for the bearer.

artefacts.name: Warmaster's Gift
artefacts.effect: [CHAOS LORD only] Each time the bearer makes a melee attack against its focus of hatred, an unmodified Wound roll of 5+ scores a Critical Wound.

artefacts.name: Cursed Fang
artefacts.effect: [HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY only] Melee weapons equipped by the bearer have +1 AP and the [PRECISION] ability.

artefacts.name: Falsehood
artefacts.effect: [CHAOS LORD only (excl. TERMINATOR/JUMP PACK)] Deploy the bearer in Reserves; it can be swapped in to replace a destroyed model and attach as a Leader.

artefacts.name: Shroud of Obfuscation
artefacts.effect: [HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY only] The bearer's unit gains Stealth and Lone Operative.

artefacts.name: Soul Link
artefacts.effect: [HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY only] The bearer gains the PSYKER keyword and copies another friendly Character's abilities until the next Command phase.

artefacts.name: Despot's Claim
artefacts.effect: [HERETIC ASTARTES only] Each Command phase, spend 1CP to return a destroyed model on a 5+ (4+ if the bearer's unit is in the enemy deployment zone).

artefacts.name: Dread Reaver
artefacts.effect: [HERETIC ASTARTES only] Re-roll Hit and Wound rolls in melee while the bearer's unit is in the enemy deployment zone.

artefacts.name: Mark of the Hound
artefacts.effect: [HERETIC ASTARTES only] The bearer's unit gains the Scouts 6" ability.

artefacts.name: Tyrant's Lash
artefacts.effect: [HERETIC ASTARTES only] Re-roll Advance rolls for the bearer's unit; it is eligible to shoot after Falling Back.

artefacts.name: Eater of Dread
artefacts.effect: [HERETIC ASTARTES only] Spend 1CP to return a destroyed model on a 5+ (+1 per Battle-shocked enemy unit within range).

artefacts.name: Night's Shroud
artefacts.effect: [CHAOS LORD only (excl. TERMINATOR)] The bearer's unit gains Stealth.

artefacts.name: Warp-fuelled Thrusters
artefacts.effect: [JUMP PACK CHAOS LORD only] If unengaged, the bearer's unit can retreat to Strategic Reserves at the end of the opponent's turn.

artefacts.name: Willbreaker
artefacts.effect: [HERETIC ASTARTES only] After the bearer's unit fights, a target unit hit must take a Battle-shock test.

armyRules.name: Dark Pacts
armyRules.effect: Each time a HERETIC ASTARTES unit is selected to shoot or fight, it can make a Dark Pact: first take a Leadership test (on a failure, that unit suffers D3 mortal wounds), then select either [LETHAL HITS] or [SUSTAINED HITS 1] for that unit's weapons of the matching type until the end of the phase.

armyRules.name: Cult of the Dark Gods
armyRules.effect: Your army can include KHORNE BERZERKERS, RUBRIC MARINES, PLAGUE MARINES, or NOISE MARINES with their Faction keyword replaced by HERETIC ASTARTES, subject to points caps by battle size (250/500/750pts for Incursion/Strike Force/Onslaught).
